title: Progressions
summary: The study of sequences and series begins by identifying the logical patterns that govern a list of numbers, transitioning from basic sequences to structured progressions. In this unit you have learned Arithmetic Progression (A.P.), in which terms increase or decrease by a steady common difference, making it the mathematical equivalent of walking at a constant pace. Conversely, unit discussed Geometric Progression (G.P.) which represents exponential change,
